title: Dec 2026 General Membership Luncheon
seo_title: Dec 2026 General Membership Luncheon in Republic, MO
description: The Republic Area Chamber of Commerce hosts the December 2026 General Membership Luncheon on Tuesday, December 1, from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM at Republic Library, 921 N Lindsey Ave in Republic, MO. Attendees who miss online registration can pay $15 at the door. The event is aimed at business networking and the local community.
price: $15 at the door for those who miss online registration
